item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera wants to measure the length of the curved edge of a round steel plate in her kitchen. She does not have a flexible measuring tape.
Which method gives the most accurate measure of the curved edge?

options.A: Measure the straight distance between the two ends of the curve with a metre scale.
options.B: Lay a thread along the curved edge, straighten the thread, and measure its length with a metre scale.
options.C: Guess the length by comparing the curve with the length of her hand span.
options.D: Measure the diameter of the plate with a ruler and use it as the length of the curve.
